text:
maria (finance): Heads up — our monthly GL review flagged two journal entries that look like duplicates for March 12th. Both NS_JR_455 and NS_JR_456 have identical amounts and memo lines. Anyone seen this pattern? 

jake (eng): Hmm could be webhook retries hitting the ns-sync consumer without idempotency. Do we have the Stripe event ids for those invoices? 

maria (finance): Attached: Stripe events evt_3KaL... and evt_3KaM... both tied to invoice inv_4LK9 and inv_4LKA. They were created 2026-03-12T03:14:02Z and 03:14:07Z. NetSuite shows two journal entries posted 3s apart. 

stripe-bot: event invoice.finalized recorded at 1864125022 for inv_4LK9; retry count=1

nathan (ops): I checked the ns-sync logs:

``
2026-03-12T03:14:02Z consume evt_3KaL
process: create_journal
idempotency_key=null
result=success -> NS_JR_455
2026-03-12T03:14:05Z consume evt_3KaL (retry)
process: create_journal
idempotency_key=null
result=success -> NS_JR_456
```

jake (eng): There's the issue — our consumer was supposed to set idempotency_key=event_id but a refactor changed the payload shape and it reads event.token which is missing in newer webhooks. I'll prepare a hotfix to read event.id and set the adapter idempotency header. 

sophie (revops): Before applying any fixes, do we need to reverse NS_JR_456? What's the recommended accounting move? 

kevin (accounting): Let's not auto-delete. We should create a reversing journal for the duplicate and tag it with a memo referencing the original event. Also we need to run a reconciliation job to find other dupes in the period. Approve reversal of exact duplicates from 2026-03-01..2026-03-15? 

maria (finance): Approved for 2026-03-01..2026-03-15 limited scope. Require a dry-run list of candidate journals and totals first. 

jake (eng): Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ns-sync/pull/418 — read event.id fallback and set X-NS-Idempotency: evt_3KaL. Also added tests for retry path. Deploying to staging. 

nathan (ops): I'll run a discovery query:```sql
SELECT ns_journal_id, memo, posted_at FROM net_suite_journals
WHERE memo LIKE '%invoice inv_%' AND posted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
ORDER BY posted_at;
```
Found 4 potential duplicates across two customers totalling $1,120.00. Dropping CSV to /shared/finance/dup-journals-1864129000.csv

sophie (revops): OK, I'll draft customer comms for the two affected customers (enterprise tier) in case the duplicate resulted in any visible billing note. 

jake (eng): Staging run shows idempotency header present and second retry is ignored by the adapter (returns 200 but no additional journal). Test log:

``
2026-03-12T03:14:05Z consume evt_3KaL (retry)
X-NS-Idempotency=evt_3KaL
adapter_response=409 duplicate idempotency -> ignored
```

nathan (ops): Dry-run reversal plan: create reversing journals for NS_JR_456, NS_JR_459, NS_JR_462, NS_JR_470 (the duplicates). Total reversing amount $1,120.00. I'll run in the maintenance window tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC, throttle 1 req/3s. 

kevin (accounting): Good. Please include reference numbers and update the GL reconciliation sheet. Also add a memo 'duplicate webhook retry - reversing journal' and tag ticket FIN-512. 

maria (finance): After reversal, confirm that AR balances still match Stripe transactions. If there's any customer-facing discrepancy, Sophie will coordinate outreach. 

stripe-bot: ns-sync deploy v2.1.9 applied idempotency fix in staging at 1864128400

jake (eng): Production deploy scheduled during the maintenance window. Also adding a monitoring alert: metric webhook_retries_without_idempotency >= 1 triggers PagerDuty. 

sophie (revops): Reversal job completed at 1864129600. Reversing journals created: NS_JR_500..NS_JR_503. CSV and NetSuite audit links uploaded. 

maria (finance): Verified reversals and GL reconciliation — AR matches Stripe. Closing out. Please follow up with postmortem documenting the refactor that removed event.token and adding unit tests for idempotency. 

kevin (accounting): Filing FIN-512 with summary and GL impact. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
